BCA, BSc Computer Science or data science
Cheaper than B.Tech, but the degree carries less brand weight, so proof of work matters more.

Scalable. Skills can be sold directly as software, dashboards or automation, so income does not wait on a rank or a licence. To grow: Ship real projects, then freelance or form a small agency. Stack AI use, automation and one business domain.
Design: B.Des, fashion, interior, UX
Admission tests reward drawing and thinking speed. Prepare a portfolio early.

Scalable. Portfolio and skill decide pay, and a designer can freelance, consult or run a studio without a rank. To grow: Build a portfolio, freelance, then specialise (UX for health or finance, brand identity) and publish case studies.
Skill-first: diploma, certificate and work
Works for digital, trade and creative fields. It does not replace a licence where one is legally required.

Scalable. You control the pace: a digital or craft skill with proof of work sells directly. To grow: Pick AI use, automation, sales, content or design, build proof, take paid projects, then consult or build an agency or product.
B.Tech / BE in computer, data or electronics
A branch or college label alone does not get hired. A visible project does.

Scalable with a business layer. Crowded when it is only a branch degree aimed at service jobs; it scales when you add product, automation or AI skills. To grow: Build and sell one tool, or take paid automation work, while you study.
B.Com or BA Economics with CA, CS or CMA
Many students spend years on repeat attempts. Keep a parallel skill running.

Scalable with a business layer. A practice can grow into advisory work, but the exam ladder is long and crowded, and many students repeat attempts. To grow: Add accounting software, data skills and a niche (tax for small firms, finance for startups) beside the exams, and move toward advisory or consulting.
Teacher education, including four-year ITEP
Pay ceiling is fixed unless you add a scalable layer such as online teaching.

Scalable with a business layer. Salary alone is capped; reach grows when you teach beyond one classroom. To grow: Build online courses, coaching, content or an education business on one subject niche.

Class 11-12 Science, Commerce or Arts
Every route in the full chart
Needs a second decision after 12th. Choose the subject mix for the doors it keeps open.
Polytechnic diploma
A junior engineering job, or lateral entry into the second year of B.Tech in many states
Check the state process for lateral entry and the branch before you join. Rated Scalable with a business layer: add automation or digital skills, or run a technical service.
ITI (trade certificate)
Trade jobs, apprenticeship and diploma routes in some states
Pay starts low. It grows when you add supervision, digital or safety skills. Rated Scalable with a business layer: offer your trade as your own service.
Skill certificate plus an open school route
Digital and creative work while you continue schooling
Needs discipline. A pile of certificates is not proof; one finished project is. Rated Scalable: you control the pace and can sell the skill directly.

Tuition ₹1,28,250 per semester (₹28,250 for SC, ST and PwD). Hostel and mess are extra.
₹1,28,250 × 8 semesters = about ₹10.3 lakh of tuition. Against the PayScale entry software average of ₹5.37 lakh, that is about 1.9 years of that pay, before living costs.
MBBS, government quota
Under ₹8 lakh for the whole course in the states compared
Only about 3 government seats per 100 NEET test-takers, so the fee is low and the competition is the real price.
MBBS, private management quota
Above ₹60 lakh for the whole course in the states compared
At least 7.5 times the government total (₹60 lakh ÷ ₹8 lakh). The seat is easier to get and far harder to repay.

supporting: 1,40,664 MBBS seats (September 2026 NMC revision) against about 22.8 lakh registrations. Around 11.2 lakh qualified in the re-exam.

The arithmetic: 1,40,664 ÷ 22.79 lakh registrations is 6.2 seats per 100. Against the 11.21 lakh who qualified it is 12.5 per 100, and government seats alone are 64,121 ÷ 20 lakh test-takers, or 3.2 per 100.

blocks.heading: Money Check Every Row Must Pass

figures.label: Education Budget Amount
figures.source: College is one part of your total education budget, not the whole of it. As a strict planning rule, not a fact of nature, keep college spending near 10% of the complete education budget when you can. If the budget is ₹10 lakh, start from about ₹1 lakh for college and keep the rest for tools, books, projects, current online learning and the years before your income stabilises.

blocks.heading: Keeps BCA, Data, Economics Honours and Quantitative

items.text: Strengthens CUET scores in Mathematics and Economics-linked papers.
Fits actuarial and analytics routes better than commerce without Maths.
Still lets you register for CA Foundation, CS and CMA.

blocks.heading: Read the Chart By Your Exam Result

items.text: Use counselling to compare colleges by course, fees and placement median, not by name alone.
Budget the whole course before you accept a seat, including hostel and coaching.
Start one small skill project before college begins so first year is not empty.
Ask what your child can finish this month, not only which college name sounds safe.
Read placement claims by median and by the number placed against the full batch.
Agree on a plan B before results, so a bad paper does not become a family crisis.
Do not judge a route by the neighbour's child.
Pick three rows from the chart.
Write the entry requirement and date for each.
Do one small task from each route.
Talk to two people inside each route.
Drop one route in writing.
